workarounds.note: every frontmatter value is quoted, since the PDF takes /Title and /Author from title and author (a YAML number or date would leave the PDF without a title)
config.locale gives the PDF its /Lang but not the captions: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) prints Figura 1.1 and Tabla 1.1
the guide is set ragged, so it is never hyphenated: locale 'es' is there for /Lang, and nothing claims Spanish hyphenation
level 1's breakBefore (parity 'any') is restated, since any headings object drops it
the presentacion heading style sets breakBefore: { enabled: false }, or it would inherit level 1's break and leave the contents alone on page 2
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, because the bands, the cover and the footer (design elements) paint the hex

the contents' leaders take the page numbers' face (toc.pageNumber.fontFamily), set to Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: in Public Sans, the face of the entries, a run of full stops kerns wider than the single dot the leader is counted from, so the dots overran into the page numbers and stopped lining up

ragged paragraphs and captions are broken without the runt penalty (avoidRunts works in justified text only), so the one-word last lines of the drafts ('mano.', 'gris.', 'barrer.', '010.', 'casa:', and 'Estación.' in the caption of table 2.1) were reworded by hand

the figure and both tables are placed inline (placement 'here' and ::resource): renderToPdf tags a page's floats after all its column text, so a floated figure would be read after the last paragraph and the table of its page
